Women in privileged spaces begin dismantling the #MeToo movement.  NICE.

@MattCalcara My takeaway from this is that women in privileged spaces will dismantle the #MeToo movement.  As a survivor of sexual abuse, it disgusts me to know that other women can't be trusted to support this movement.

@Andy_Olsen @ddayen Who says that #MeToo was exploited? That is not a "fact" in "evidence" -- it is an opinion on your part. IF the first accuser was a tool, many others stepped up. But those voices don't count as long as one voice is a conservative who you have decided was dishonest.

@Andy_Olsen @ddayen ALSO - do you want to know what helped Trump here? White male privilege and wealth privilege. This has been the case for CENTURIES. What are you doing about that?  I am supporting #MeToo because #IBelieveWomen no matter their political leaning.

@Andy_Olsen @ddayen Letting men and their owned media and their controlled government, law enforcement and jurisprudence doesn't do that either. Women started the #MeToo movement to end the injustices inherent on the system. #IBelieveWomen

@Andy_Olsen @ddayen There currently is no new system in place to make sure that women's voices are heard when they are victims. #MeToo is predicated on the idea that all women (and their male allies in the cause) stand together in numbers such that women get justice. 1/2

@Andy_Olsen @ddayen So when the new standards are in place, then we can use them. Until they are, I will support the #MeToo movement by believing women.  Also the other women that stepped forward are silenced in this conversation-- all of the focus is on the first accuser. 2/2
